project.title: Mixed-Waste Sorting Line Safety and Efficiency Upgrade
project.objective: Standardise and improve the mixed-waste sorting line to boost throughput and safety while reducing contamination and incident risk.
deliverables: Standard operating procedure for mixed-waste sorting and handling
Updated workstation layout and material flow for the sorting line
Contamination reduction checklist and training briefings
Hazardous waste handling and storage guideline
Daily cleaning and inspection routine for sorting equipment
Incident reporting and escalation quick-reference sheet
constraints: All changes must be implementable without full line shutdowns longer than 2 hours
Must comply with internal health, safety and hygiene legislation
Hazardous waste handling must follow existing dangerous goods rules
No new powered machinery purchases; only reconfiguration and small tools
Training must be deliverable in short on-shift huddles (max 20 minutes)
Documentation must be understandable for all shifts and literacy levels

risks.risk: Line downtime increases during reconfiguration and trials.
risks.mitigation: Plan changes in small steps during low-volume windows and coordinate with shift supervisors.

risks.risk: Staff do not consistently follow new sorting and cleaning routines.
risks.mitigation: Co-create routines with operators, run short refreshers, and post clear visual aids at workstations.

risks.risk: Hazardous materials are misclassified during new process rollout.
risks.mitigation: Create simple visual guide for hazardous items and require double-check by a designated worker per shift.

risks.risk: New layout creates unexpected safety hazards or congestion.
risks.mitigation: Pilot layout on one section, collect feedback, and adjust before full rollout.

risks.risk: Incident reporting remains informal and incomplete.
risks.mitigation: Introduce a simple incident card and quick-reference sheet, and review examples in toolbox talks.

themes.why_relevant: Directly affects throughput, ergonomics, and how easily workers can separate and move materials.
Reduces risk of pollution incidents and ensures compliance with dangerous goods rules.
Keeps equipment reliable, work areas safe, and supports hygiene legislation compliance.
Workers handle heavy loads, chemicals and sharp objects; clear rules reduce injuries.
Short, clear briefings ensure all shifts apply the same procedures and report issues consistently.

backlog.task: Map current mixed-waste sorting workflow and identify bottlenecks on each shift
definition_of_done: Simple map of current material flow created for each shift
Top 5 bottlenecks or pain points listed with short notes
Shared with recycling workers and shift supervisors for validation

backlog.task: Draft standard operating procedure for sorting and removing contaminants
definition_of_done: Step-by-step SOP drafted covering sorting, removal of contaminants and handling of dangerous goods
Reviewed by at least one factory hand and health and safety officer
Key steps highlighted for use in visual posters

backlog.task: Design and test a contamination reduction checklist at the sorting line
definition_of_done: Checklist created with clear, short items for each load
Pilot run on at least three shifts with feedback collected
Revised version agreed for daily use

backlog.task: Propose improved workstation layout for safer material handling and forklift access
definition_of_done: Sketch of new layout including container positions and forklift paths
Checked against safety clearances and emergency exits
Approved by shift supervisor and maintenance technician

backlog.task: Create hazardous waste handling and storage guideline for the sorting area
definition_of_done: Guideline lists common hazardous items and how to drain, store and label them
Storage zones and containers clearly defined
Reviewed by health and safety officer for compliance

backlog.task: Define daily cleaning and inspection routine for sorting equipment and floors
definition_of_done: Checklist of cleaning and inspection tasks by time of day created
Includes PPE requirements and cleaning products to use
Tested on at least two shifts and adjusted based on feedback

backlog.task: Set up simple incident and near-miss reporting process for pollution and safety events
definition_of_done: Incident reporting quick-reference sheet drafted
Example scenarios added for pollution and injury risks
Process validated with shift supervisor and posted in sorting area

backlog.task: Prepare short training huddle script for new sorting and cleaning routines
definition_of_done: 10–15 minute script covering key changes and reasons created
Includes prompts to check understanding with workers
Used in at least one toolbox talk and refined

backlog.task: Align recycling collection schedules with new workflow to avoid pile-ups
definition_of_done: Current collection schedule compared with peak sorting times
Proposed adjustments documented and shared with logistics
New schedule tested for at least two days without major pile-ups

backlog.task: Define PPE and safety signage needs for the updated sorting line
definition_of_done: List of required PPE by task compiled
Missing signage and labels identified and listed
List shared with health and safety officer for ordering and installation

backlog.task: Document best practices for educating new staff on recycling regulations on the line
definition_of_done: Short guideline created for on-the-job coaching of new staff
Includes examples of correct vs incorrect sorting
Reviewed with at least one experienced factory hand

backlog.task: Set up a simple rotation plan to balance heavy and light tasks on the line
definition_of_done: Rotation pattern drafted for a full shift, mixing heavy and light duties
Checked for coverage of all key positions
Trialed on one shift and adjusted based on worker feedback

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current sorting workflow, main bottlenecks and safety pain points.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to describe how the line runs today and where it hurts most.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the top three bottlenecks to address first on the sorting line.
Confirm which section of the line will be used as the pilot area for changes.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and lock the standard sorting and contamination control procedure.
threads_plan.trigger: Share first draft of the sorting SOP and ask for concrete edits from operators.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the mixed-waste sorting SOP for rollout.
Select the contamination checklist items that must be used on every load.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on new layout, rotation plan and cleaning routine for the pilot area.
threads_plan.trigger: Post proposed layout sketch, rotation schedule and cleaning checklist for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the new workstation layout and forklift paths for the pilot section.
Approve the daily cleaning and inspection routine and who signs it off.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock hazardous waste handling rules and incident reporting process.
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft hazardous waste guide and incident quick reference for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the hazardous waste handling and storage guideline for the sorting area.
Agree on the simple incident reporting steps everyone must follow.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan training huddles, PPE needs and go-live date for new routines.
threads_plan.trigger: Post toolbox talk script and ask for final tweaks and training schedule.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Set the go-live date for the new sorting, cleaning and reporting routines.
Confirm PPE and signage updates required before go-live.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in at shift start to flag issues on the sorting line and progress on tasks.
Mid-week layout and process review thread to capture quick wins and problems from the pilot area.
Weekly safety and incident recap summarising reported events and follow-up actions.
Pre-go-live readiness checklist review to confirm SOPs, training and signage are in place.
Post-implementation retrospective after two weeks to adjust routines and documents.
